BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                           OF THE STATE OF MISSOURI


In the Matter of Evergy Metro, Inc. d/b/a Evergy
Missouri Metro’s Request for Authority to               File No. ER-2026-0143
Implement a General Rate Increase for Electric
Service

     Request for Witness Katherine Wyszkowski to Appear Remotely and Request for
                                 Expedited Treatment

       COMES NOW Renew Missouri Advocates d/b/a Renew Missouri, by and through the

undersigned counsel, and requests permission for its witness Katherine Wyszkowski to appear

remotely on an expedited basis. In support thereof, Renew states as follows:

       1. On September 24, 2026, parties to proceeding filed a Joint List Of Issues, Order Of

            Opening Statements, Order Of Cross-Examination, And Order Of Issues And

            Witnesses. In that filing, Ms. Wyszkowski was scheduled to appear during the second

            week of the hearing.

       2.   Yesterday, on October 5, 2026, during a break in the evidentiary hearing, parties

            collaborated to produce an updated hearing schedule to reflect issue resolution and to

            formalize particular dates for remaining issues. This Amended Joint List Of Issues,

            Order Of Opening Statements, Order Of Cross-Examination, And Order Of Issues And

            Witnesses was filed at 1:08 pm, and Renew Missouri appreciates the diligent work of

            the parties to produce a procedural schedule that incorporates dozens of conflicts,

            witnesses, and topics. In this amended schedule, Ms. Wyszkowsi’s sole issue, Green

            Button Connect, was rescheduled to tomorrow, Wednesday October 7, 2026.

       3. Ms. Wyszkowski, an out of state expert, can accommodate this new scheduling via a

            remote appearance, which she respectfully requests. Furthermore, granting this

            accommodation also provides additional flexibility for the Commission and the parties,
            if further schedule changes are required. Counsel for Renew Missouri will attend in

           person.

       4. Counsel understands from discussions among the parties that no party objects to this

           request.

       5. Good cause exists under 20 CSR 4240-2.080(14) to grant expedited treatment in

           permitting Ms. Wyszkowski’s limited remote appearance to allow the hearing to

           proceed as efficiently and with limited delays. Ms. Wyszkowski will be available for

           questions from parties and Commissioners, so parties will retain all due process rights.

           This pleading was filed as soon as practicable, the next day after the schedule was

           formally changed.

       WHEREFORE, Renew Missouri respectfully requests the Commission grant Ms.

Wyszkowski’s request to appear remotely for her as currently scheduled Wednesday October 7th,

2026, testimony, or as such date the witness may be called in the current proceeding, and any other

further relief it finds appropriate in the circumstances.

                                       Respectfully submitted,

                                                                    /s/Nicole Mers
                                                                    Nicole Mers
                                                                    Bar No. 66766
                                                                    501 Fay Street
                                                                    Suite 206
                                                                    Columbia, MO 65201
                                                                    Phone: 314-308-2729
                                                                    nicole@renewmo.org

                                   CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE

   I hereby certify that copies of the foregoing have been emailed to all counsel of record this 6th

   day of October 2026.

                                                             /s/ Nicole Mers
